easy.formula: tank-days with one cleaning day per batch = bch fmd + bch
gravity samples: one a day plus 2 per batch = bch (fmd + 2)
kegs for every litre = ceil(lit / lpk)
pallets for those kegs = ceil(ceil(lit / lpk) / kpp)
pallets of full kegs = (lit // lpk) // kpp
litres left after the full kegs = lit mod lpk
empty litres in the last keg = lpk ceil(lit / lpk) - lit
full kegs left off the full pallets = (lit // lpk) mod kpp
ordered side-by-side comparisons of two taps = tpx (tpx - 1)
seats = trn cgt spc
couplings between carriages = trn (cgt - 1)
corridor area with a 1-unit drain each side = tkl (tkw + 2)
sum of the squared sides = tkl^2 + tkw^2
wagons for every tonne = ceil(frt / wpt)
trains for those wagons = ceil(ceil(frt / wpt) / wgc)
trains of full wagons = (frt // wpt) // wgc
full wagons left off the full trains = (frt // wpt) mod wgc
spare tonnes in the last wagon = wpt ceil(frt / wpt) - frt
departures including the last train = dph rnh + 1
movements, both directions = 2 dph rnh
machine loads for every kg = ceil(kgl / kpm)
rounds of all machines = ceil(ceil(kgl / kpm) / mch)
full loads = kgl // kpm
kg in the part load = kgl mod kpm
sum of the squared sides = bdw^2 + bdl^2
loads a week = wsh lpd dop

hard.formula: litres after a 10-litre sampling loss per batch = bch (lbt - 10)
fermentation weeks started, all batches = bch ceil(fmd / 7)
releases: every batch alone and every blend of two = bch (bch + 1) / 2
tasting litres: 2 per batch-day = 2 bch fmd, plus one litre per batch
pints at 12 per tap-hour = 12 tpx opn
line cleans: every 4 hours plus once at close, per tap = tpx (opn // 4 + 1)
bar staff, one per 6 taps rounded up, each hour = opn ceil(tpx / 6)
glasses: 12 pints per tap-hour plus 20 spare = 12 tpx opn + 20
one carriage per train at half seating = trn ((cgt - 1) spc + spc // 2)
doors: 4 per carriage and 2 cab doors per train = 4 trn cgt + 2 trn
capacity with 20 standing per carriage = trn cgt (spc + 20)
the verge itself = tkl tkw - (tkl - 2)(tkw - 2)
3-wide ballast strips along the length = tkl ceil(tkw / 3)
crews, one per 4 departures rounded up, each hour = rnh ceil(dph / 4)
pairs of departures that could meet = dph rnh (dph rnh - 1) / 2
machine slots unused in the last round = mch ceil(ceil(kgl/kpm)/mch) - ceil(kgl/kpm)
flat sheet with a 2-unit tuck on every side = (bdw + 4)(bdl + 4)
one quarter after folding in half both ways = (bdw // 2)(bdl // 2)
flat and fitted sheet plus a pillow strip = 2 bdw bdl + 2 bdw
loads with one service slot per washer-day = wsh dop (lpd - 1)
detergent scoops: 2 per load plus 1 per washer-day = wsh dop (2 lpd + 1)
washer pairs scheduled together, each day = dop wsh (wsh - 1) / 2
tokens: one per load plus 3 per washer = wsh lpd dop + 3 wsh
